explanation: New and extended tests for the Visium provider: externalReference.test.ts checks the manifest (regions as groups, 121 donor-region samples, display-local donors, allow-listed metadata, sparse POA/ME/MAM, compartments, CC BY attribution), Pomc to POMC, measured zeros, IGF2 not measured, the derived-CPM validation report and the CSV source_credit column. regionalSummary.test.ts covers one donor in two regions. portalCards, deployGuards, sourceJson and expressionSurvey tests cover the tile, the built-vs-fetched atlas split, the transport allow-list and the new CSV column.
